text:
alex_cs: Heads-up: HelioCare wants to kick off a blended US+EU pilot next week. They asked for two config changes before traffic starts: enable eu-central-1 and us-east-2, add an allowlist for their egress proxies, and grant a short-term per-route QPS lift for /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. They also want the rules auto-expire after 96h.

pat_net: Got it. Need exact CIDRs, which regions to apply to (global vs region-specific), and whether they want a canary. Also confirm auto-revoke window 96h.

lucy_helio: hi all 9;morning. CIDRs: 198.51.200.0/24, 203.0.113.0/26. Apply to eu-central-1 and us-east-2 only. No BGP peering, just standard IP allowlist. Canary would be helpful on chat route.

maria_se: For safety we'll scope the QPS bump to per-minute windows and per-route ceilings. Proposed: /v1/chat -> 60 QPS, /v1/embeddings -> 18 QPS, expires 96h, tag helio-pilot-2333333333. We'll keep embeddings conservative to avoid background bulk calls.

jo-support: Noting renewal watch: HelioCare's contract up in 7 months and usage baseline low. Pilot success will be key for upsell. Scheduling enablement training during day 2 of pilot.

pat_net: Planning to create ephemeral edge rules. Do you want the same CIDR in both regions or split? Also will add a canary (5%) to eu-central-1 on /v1/chat and metrics alert for p95 latency >250ms.

lucy_helio: Split is fine: 198.51.200.0/24 to eu-central-1, 203.0.113.0/26 to us-east-2. Canary 5% on eu-central-1 good. Please keep auto-revoke at 96h. If stable we will request permanent allowlist after pilot.

maria_se: Applying quota override now with admin tag helio-pilot-2333333333. Sample patch we used: ```{ "account":"heliocare", "overrides":[{"route":"/v1/chat","qps":60},{"route":"/v1/embeddings","qps":18}], "expires_in":"96h", "tag":"helio-pilot-2333333333" }```

pat_net: deploy-bot: starting ephemeral-allowlist (ea-2333333333) to eu-central-1/us-east-2.

audit-bot: audit: allowlist-create ea-2333333333 by pat_net at 2333333360.

pat_net: Done 1: allowlist applied. eu-central-1 -> 198.51.200.0/24, us-east-2 -> 203.0.113.0/26. Auto-revoke scheduled at 96h. Canary on /v1/chat eu-central-1 set to 5%. Added p95 latency alert and error-rate alert on the route.

lucy_helio: Confirming hits in us-east-2. Seeing initial chat flows at ~8 QPS, embeddings at ~2 QPS. Latency fine. Thanks!

jo-support: Documented follow-ups in CRM: daily pilot checkins, enablement on day 2, renewal note flagged as opportunity if pilot expands.

maria_se: FYI I also tightened the burst token bucket (burst=20) to prevent sudden spikes. If Helio needs higher burst we can adjust but prefer to monitor first 24h.

lucy_helio: One ask: If the pilot looks good can we extend expiry by 48h without a ticket? We may need to align with our compliance window.

alex_cs: CS can approve one-console extension up to +48h. We'll record approval in the pilot ticket.

pat_net: Logged CLI commands and audit ids in the ops ticket. If anyone wants the snippets I'll paste them.

lucy_helio: Appreciate it. We'll start our ramp tomorrow morning and report back.

alex_cs: Great. Actions: ops monitor alerts, CS runbook enablement on day 2, support to watch renewal metric. Closing for now and will reopen if any issues. Thanks team.
